name: Finnu Designs
old_description: We have been adding value and style to homes, offices, restaurants, and more since 2014. We would love to work on your next project for you!
about:
Finnu Designs, based in West Fargo, North Dakota, was founded in 2014 by Josh Humble. The company began as a woodworking venture and expanded into a multidisciplinary design studio working with wood, metal, and stone.

The shop produces custom built-in cabinetry, one-of-a-kind furniture, and home goods, guiding clients through a six-step process that covers concept, creative design, planning, building, delivery, and a 30-day follow-up inspection. The team handles woodworking, metal fabrication, and stone fabrication in-house, and manages installation on site.

Finnu serves both residential and commercial customers, including homeowners, office developers, and restaurant operators. Past projects include a barn door for a private residence, a dining table for a homeowner, and collaborative work with Mosaic Design & Build on commercial interiors.

The company emphasizes a “Quality Craftsmanship Guarantee” and a culture summed up as “Once a Finnu’er, always a Finnu’er.” Every build ships with a care package, and the crew pledges to leave each job site in the same or better condition than they found it.
